basics.name: Arkobrato Gupta
basics.summary: PhD candidate in Biostatistics at The Ohio State University (GPA: 3.88/4.0; advisor: Dr. Dongjun Chung), with industry experience at Novartis and Abbott spanning clinical-trial design and analysis, statistical analysis plans, regulatory submissions, and real-world evidence. Skilled in Bayesian methods, causal inference, biomarker/genetic analysis, and machine learning; proficient in R and SAS. 6 peer-reviewed papers (including Scientific Reports, American Journal of Psychiatry, Molecular Psychiatry) and 4 preprints.

highlights: Analyzed a propensity-matched NHANES cohort (n = 6,508; 2011-2018): adults consuming ≥1.2 g/kg/day protein had 1.2% greater lean soft tissue (p < 0.001), independent of physical activity, supporting protein guidelines for healthy aging. Owned the full analysis lifecycle: cohort definition, statistical method selection, confounder adjustment, and inference
Accepted for poster presentation at ICFSR 2026 (Washington, DC)

Conducted an individual participant data (IPD) meta-analysis of 14 clinical trials using both two-stage and one-stage (mixed-effects) approaches, and explored mixture models to capture heterogeneity in intervention effects on key health outcomes

work.company: The Ohio State University Comprehensive Cancer Center
work.summary: Columbus, OH • Pelotonia Institute for Immuno-Oncology
highlights: SRT: statistical framework integrating spatial TCR-seq and spatial transcriptomics (earth-mover's distance + Gaussian-mixture FDR control); identified 878 genes coupled with T-cell clonal diversity in glioblastoma, enabling biomarker discovery in the tumor microenvironment

Opioid use disorder: developed a Bayesian stochastic block model clustering framework for 900+ genetically diverse rats, classifying vulnerable/intermediate/resilient phenotypes and revealing sex-specific subgroups within the vulnerable phenotype

SCOPE: R Shiny app implementing the Bayesian stochastic block model clustering framework (modularity-initialized Gibbs sampling with posterior uncertainty quantification), adopted by 5+ labs in the USA, Italy, and the UK
graph-GPA 2.0 (co-first author; Frontiers in Genetics, 2023): Bayesian graphical model integrating GWAS summary statistics across multiple diseases with functional annotation data
Co-led a genome-wide EWAS (co-first author; Scientific Reports, 2025) identifying 736 differentially methylated loci between Native Hawaiian and White women
Estimated epigenetic age and age acceleration from EPIC methylation data in advanced NSCLC (Beating Lung Cancer in Ohio study, 2025)
Statistical analyses of clinical, histopathologic, and gene expression data from 75 dogs with soft tissue sarcoma (Cancers, 2025), a comparative oncology model for human disease
Analyzed public glioblastoma scRNA-seq data (100,000+ cells) to annotate myeloid populations and profile immune checkpoint ligand expression, supporting a grant application (2025)
Programmed SDTM and ADaM datasets and TFLs in SAS and R to CDISC standards for three clinical trials, including the pivotal Phase III study of Kisqali (ribociclib) in breast cancer
Provided statistical programming support for early-phase studies with the Novartis Institutes for BioMedical Research (NIBR)
Implemented statistical methods specified in SAPs, working with trial statisticians on analysis specifications and outputs
Performed independent double programming and QC validation of datasets and outputs for submission readiness
Built reporting databases supporting regulatory submissions across solid-tumor oncology and respiratory therapeutic areas

highlights: Led sections for PUBHBIO 2210 (Biostatistics for Public Health Research, undergraduate) and PUBHBIO 6270 (Introduction to SAS for Public Health Students, graduate)
Collaborated with a multidisciplinary team to quantify public support for nuclear energy using survey data and regression analysis

highlights: Analyzed national sample survey data using logistic regression and survey methods to identify determinants of catastrophic health expenditure in India; presented findings to the Ministry
